messages:
alex: Heads-up: NVIDIA GPU firmware rollout scheduled Tue 03/31 01:00-03:00 UTC for select inference clusters (us-west-2 & eu-central-1). Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m observation windows. Automatic rollback on >2% p99 latency spike or >1% error increase.
maria: Link to the ticket? need to notify Dedicated customers and update statuspage.
alex: https://redwood.internal/ops/tickets/RI-2189 — will post to status early tomorrow. Dedicated CSMs already pinged.
sam: Does this require node reboots? impact to KV cache warmup?
alex: Yes, nodes do a microcode reload causing short ML runtime restarts (~30–90s per GPU). Expect KV cache to miss on restarted pods; we'll run a small loadtest as part of the canary to validate warmup.
tao: Suggest we enable model-routing fallback to smaller quantized variant during canary in case latency jumps. I can push a routing policy change to divert 10% to q4_0 variant.
kate: +1. Also add a temporary SLO guardrail: allow p99 to exceed baseline by up to 15% during the maintenance window but mark any customer-facing SLA alerts.
sam: We should also surface per-customer impact for Dedicated customers with pinned models. Those might not have q4 variants.
maria: For Dedicated, we'll put a short maintenance advisory and an opt-out flag for firmware until they sign off. Ops to collate list.
alex: Preflight checklist (short):
```
- run `kubectl cordon` on target GKE nodes
- `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` on pods running inference
- deploy temporary routing rule: route 10% to fallback model
- start canary-loadtest job: `jobs/canary-gpu-fw-check`
```
Please don't run full drains until canary looks good.
sre-bot: deploy-bot scheduled canary job at 2026-03-31T01:05:00Z (job id: canary-186300). Will post results in this thread.
deploy-bot: Canary job queued — running in us-west-2 canary pool (5% traffic). Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/canary-186300/logs
maria: If canary passes, what's the ramp cadence? 
tao: 5% -> wait 30m -> check telemetry -> 25% -> wait 30m -> check -> 100% or stop. Manual hold allowed at each step.
kate: Telemetry checks: p99 latency, error rate, model output drift (sanity eval), GPU restart counts, pod OOMs. If any check fails, rollback to previous step and open RI-2189-rollback.
sam: Can we simulate a worst-case by inducing KV cache misses before canary? I can run a small eviction test to emulate cold cache.
alex: Yes, run `curl` load pattern that includes new user prefixes to avoid cache hits. Keep within 5% traffic cap.
maria: Paging: On-call SRE -> full page if >1% customer error increase for 10m. Otherwise post to eng-sre channel and tag oncall.
ta o: typo — tao: also add a prom alert threshold for GPU microcode reboots: `gpu_reboots_total` delta > 5 in 15m -> page.
sre-bot: Alert rule created: `RB-GPU-FW-REBOOT-PAGE`. Thresholds match above.
deploy-bot: Canary run finished: quick summary: p99 +8%, errors +0.2%, 2 pods restarted (expected). Full logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/canary-186300/results
kate: That's within canary pass thresholds. Proceed to 25% at 01:40 UTC.
alex: Rolling to 25% now. Please stand by for telemetry.
maria: Posting maintenance advisory to customers now.
sam: Running cold-cache eviction test now (5% load). Will post results in ~10m.
deploy-bot: 25% roll finished: p99 +12%, errors +0.9%, no unexplained model divergence. Continuing hold.
kate: Still acceptable under temporary SLO guardrail. Plan to finish full rollout at 02:30 if nothing regress.
maria: Dedicated customers who opted out: 3 accounts — flagged to postpone until next maintenance cycle.
tao: Reminder: after rollout, run background KV cache warmup job for 2h to reduce long-tail latencies. I'll schedule `kvcache-warmup-186300`.
alex: Thanks everyone. Post-mortem note: collect warmup curves and per-model latencies for next run. If anything odd surfaces, tag RI-2189 and escalate. :thumbsup:
